economic_hypothesis: A strict low-inventory true gap formed after at least a 30% decline from the highest coordinate high in the prior 120 completed sessions is more likely to be part of a meaningful liquidation episode than an ordinary sideways-market gap. The unchanged first daily reversal below L may then retain more absolute rebound economics.
